name: OTP Verification
annotation: HIFI-03b · /auth/verify · warm-light auth shell (peach blush corners, white cards, ink text)

modules.build: Transparent variant, single leading chevron (44px target), no title, no trailing actions. Stays transparent for the whole screen life — this canvas never scrolls.
Balencia | Verify your *email* | We sent a 4-digit code to j***@... (honest-null fallback if address payload missing: 'We sent a 4-digit code to your email.')

4 circular 54-58px cells (12px gaps), white fill, 1px warm-gray ring, centered digit/dash. Cell 1 (focus): 1.5px burnt-orange border + soft glow bleed (--glow-you). Error: solid 2px burnt-orange border, no glow.
Empty / invisible by default. On error: paper-100 status copy appears below cells — not a danger color, the copy itself carries the warmth.

Resend code (0:59) — ChargeMeter depleting orange fill + tabular countdown; BtnGhost resend label (orange, 44px target), disabled/muted while draining. Success: 'Code sent', meter snaps full with --glow-done flash, resumes orange drain.
verify. (BtnPrimary, orange fill, full width, 52pt tall). Disabled 40% opacity until 4 digits present. Loading = spinner-only, no text label. Success = 600ms green pulse, then push to 03c.

trustControls: Masked email (j***@email.com) prevents account enumeration; honest-null fallback 'We sent a 4-digit code to your email.' if the address payload is missing — never fabricates a fake address
ChargeMeter honest-null: resend cooldown stays hidden until the server confirms the code actually dispatched — no countdown ever shown for a code that may not exist yet
No skeleton state — no server-fetched layout to mask; a skeleton here would be theater, not honesty
OfflineBanner variant reuses the one catalog honest-status pattern (no bespoke toast fragment) for both the offline and rate-limited cases
Rate-limited variant drops CTA, cells, and resend to 40% opacity (standard catalog disabled value, not bespoke) with a live-region countdown inside the banner
Expired, invalid, and rate-limited states never reveal whether another email has an account
notes: Route strictly aligned to /auth/verify — no alternate vanity routes
Figma alias 'Opt Verification' is a typo; treat as OTP verification in canonical copy, never propagate the typo into production labels
Dark glass OTP cells are a theme variant only; the Figma-aligned build uses white circular cells with 1px warm-gray rings
Error (invalid code): solid 2px burnt-orange border, NO glow — glow is reserved for active/positive states; a breathing glow on a wrong code would read as 'good, keep going'
Shake (3 oscillations) only triggers on the 3rd consecutive miss; cells clear and focus returns to cell 1
BtnPrimary loading is spinner-only (label -> spinner, width locked) — no 'Verifying' text label
Reduced motion: shake skipped; breathing/pulsing glows replaced by static equivalents (fixed 1.5px orange focus border, fixed 2px orange error border)
